name: bZx iETH self-transfer duplication

classification.summary: LoanTokenLogic's _internalTransferFrom cached the sender and receiver balances before writing them and never rejected _from == _to, so each self-transfer of iETH credited the receiver without debiting the sender and doubled the attacker's iETH before burnToEther().

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

lastCodeChange.description: 2020-09-04T19:53:15Z (block 10796875, tx 0x689cc627a562f892ab36edd8b29c6557bedb17c78f80bb26ddaa577aa460cd6c): setTarget(address) wrote target_ (storage slot 20) = 0xde744d544a9d768e96c21b5f087fc54b776e9b25, the LoanTokenLogicWeth implementation containing the flawed _internalTransferFrom; located by binary-searching eth_getStorageAt on slot 20

limitations: Target identity and code history came from the v1 snapshot row originally at protocols/bzx.json; no semantic revalidation was inherited.

sources.note: onchain review: iETH token 0xb983e014 created 2020-09-03 by 0xb7f72028d9b502dc871c444363a7ac5a52546608 (bZx deployer), not by attack sender 0xd1c0f131; it is a bZx setTarget proxy that emits no EIP-1967 Upgraded event, so the logic pointer was recovered by binary-searching eth_getStorageAt on target_ (storage slot 20, from the verified LoanTokenLogicWeth layout) between the creation and incident blocks: it held 0x11ba2b39bc80464c14b7eea54d2ec93d8f60e7b8 at deployment, then 0xe8279915fe5fb202041c3b3bf97d0f95949d503f, and was last written to 0xde744d544a9d768e96c21b5f087fc54b776e9b25 at block 10796875, 2020-09-04T19:53:15Z by setTarget(address) tx 0x689cc627a562f892ab36edd8b29c6557bedb17c78f80bb26ddaa577aa460cd6c from the deployer, and stayed there through the incident; 0xde744d54 is the LoanTokenLogicWeth carrying the flawed _internalTransferFrom, so the real code age is 8.55d rather than the 10.36d deployment figure

limitations: Classification and loss came from the v1 snapshot row originally at protocols/bzx.json; legacy measurement.status=OK is provenance only.
The legacy USD loss lacks uniformly structured valuation provenance.
